datasets.name: ds_reason_breakdown
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(f.reason_category, 'Unknown') AS reason_category,
  COUNT(*) AS removal_count
FROM
  ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.vw_prop_fact_component_removal f
    JOIN ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.qx_ppmtx_gold_dim_date d
      ON f.transaction_date_key = d.dim_date_key
WHERE
  d.calendar_date >= :date_range.min
  AND d.calendar_date <= :date_range.max
GROUP BY
  reason_category
ORDER BY
  removal_count DESC

datasets.name: ds_removal_trend_weekly
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', d.calendar_date) AS week_start,
  COUNT(*) AS removal_count,
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN f.schedule_category = 'Unscheduled' THEN 1
    END
  ) AS unscheduled_count,
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN f.schedule_category = 'Scheduled' THEN 1
    END
  ) AS scheduled_count
FROM
  ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.vw_prop_fact_component_removal f
    JOIN ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.qx_ppmtx_gold_dim_date d
      ON f.transaction_date_key = d.dim_date_key
WHERE
  d.calendar_date >= :date_range.min
  AND d.calendar_date <= :date_range.max
  -- Excluded: week of Nov 24, 2025 contained 4,506 records bulk-loaded with the TRAX
  -- initial export date as the transaction date (vs. normal baseline of ~8–32/week).
  AND NOT (d.calendar_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30')
GROUP BY
  DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', d.calendar_date)
ORDER BY
  week_start

datasets.name: ds_defect_part_linkage
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.fact_defect_key) AS total_defects,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.bridge_defect_part_key) AS linked_defects,
  COALESCE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bridge_defect_part_key) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.fact_defect_key), 0),
    0
  ) AS linkage_rate
FROM
  ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.vw_prop_fact_defect f
    LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.vw_prop_bridge_defect_part b
      ON f.defect_type = b.defect_type
      AND f.defect = b.defect
      AND f.defect_item = b.defect_item
    JOIN ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.qx_ppmtx_gold_dim_date d
      ON f.reported_date_key = d.dim_date_key
WHERE
  d.calendar_date >= :date_range.min
  AND d.calendar_date <= :date_range.max

datasets.name: ds_defect_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_defects,
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN f.delay = 'Y' THEN 1
    END
  ) AS delay_events,
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN f.cancellation = 'Y' THEN 1
    END
  ) AS cancellations,
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN f.i_f_s_d = 'Y' THEN 1
    END
  ) AS ifsds,
  COALESCE(SUM(f.delays_hours), 0) AS total_delay_hours,
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN
        f.defer = 'Y'
        OR f.mel = 'Y'
      THEN
        1
    END
  ) AS deferrals
FROM
  ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.vw_prop_fact_defect f
    JOIN ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.qx_ppmtx_gold_dim_date d

datasets.name: ds_llp_redline
queryLines:
SELECT
  p.pn,
  COALESCE(p.pn_description, p.pn) AS part_name,
  c.sn,
  c.control AS control_type,
  c.remaining_cycles,
  c.remaining_hours,
  c.schedule_cycles AS limit_cycles,
  c.schedule_hours AS limit_hours
FROM
  ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.vw_prop_fact_inventory_control c
    JOIN ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.qx_ppmtx_gold_dim_part p
      ON c.dim_part_key = p.dim_part_key
WHERE
  (
    c.remaining_cycles IS NOT NULL
    AND c.remaining_cycles < 1000
  )
  OR (
    c.remaining_hours IS NOT NULL
    AND c.remaining_hours < 2000
  )
ORDER BY
  c.remaining_cycles ASC

GROUP BY
  c.chapter_description
ORDER BY
  delay_minutes DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_dq_scorecard
queryLines:
SELECT
  'Defect-Part Linkage' AS metric,
  COALESCE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bridge_defect_part_key) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.fact_defect_key), 0),
    0
  ) AS score
FROM
  ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.vw_prop_fact_defect f
    LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.vw_prop_bridge_defect_part b
      ON f.defect_type = b.defect_type
      AND f.defect = b.defect
      AND f.defect_item = b.defect_item

datasets.name: ds_inventory_health
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN s.condition = 'SVC' THEN 1
    END
  )
    * 1.0
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS serviceable_ratio,
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN s.condition = 'AOG' THEN 1
    END
  ) AS aog_count,
  COUNT(*) AS total_instances
FROM
  ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.vw_prop_fact_inventory_snapshot s

datasets.name: ds_filter_ata_chapters
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  chapter_description
FROM
  ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.qx_ppmtx_gold_dim_ata_chapter
WHERE
  chapter_description IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  chapter_description

datasets.name: ds_filter_stations
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  station_code
FROM
  ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.qx_ppmtx_gold_dim_station
WHERE
  station_code IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  station_code

datasets.name: ds_filter_part_numbers
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  pn,
  COALESCE(pn_description, pn) AS pn_label
FROM
  ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.qx_ppmtx_gold_dim_part
WHERE
  pn IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  pn

datasets.name: ds_filter_aircraft
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  ac
FROM
  ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.qx_ppmtx_gold_dim_aircraft
WHERE
  ac IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  ac

datasets.name: ds_dec29_spike_detail
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(p.pn_description, p.pn) AS part_name,
  p.pn,
  c.chapter_description,
  f.schedule_category,
  COALESCE(f.reason_category, 'Unknown') AS reason_category,
  COUNT(*) AS removal_count
FROM
  ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.vw_prop_fact_component_removal f
    JOIN ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.qx_ppmtx_gold_dim_date d
      ON f.transaction_date_key = d.dim_date_key
    JOIN ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.qx_ppmtx_gold_dim_part p
      ON f.dim_part_key = p.dim_part_key
    JOIN ${catalog}.${gold_schema}.qx_ppmtx_gold_dim_ata_chapter c
      ON f.dim_ata_chapter_key = c.dim_ata_chapter_key
WHERE
  d.calendar_date BETWEEN '2025-12-15' AND '2025-12-28'
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  removal_count DESC
LIMIT 25
